topics.name: Operational Runbook Identity
topics.purpose: Define each operational procedure as a versioned non-executing guidance/workflow identity composed of exact checks and operation bindings.

semantics.operation_rule: Effectful steps bind exact canonical operations rather than free-form shell side effects where modeled.
semantics.manual_rule: Human instructions remain guidance until an explicit operation is requested.
semantics.version_rule: Operators use exact accepted runbook revision.
semantics.authority_rule: Runbook visibility never grants execution rights.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.
